== Usage ==
For preloading the header into "''Introduced with such and such a game version something or other''" Category pages.

== Example ==
This template is built for preloading and '''cannot''' be used with {{hl|{{<nowiki/>{{PAGENAME}}}}}}; to introduce the same effect manually, copy/paste this:

[[Category:{{subst:#explode:{{subst:PAGENAME}}|version|0}}|{{subst:#replace:{{subst:#explode:{{subst:PAGENAME}}|version|1}}| |}}]]</nowiki></code>[[Category:Templates|{{uc:{{PAGENAME}}}}]]</noinclude>
